queueConflict: This queued message was edited elsewhere. Your edits are kept; reopen the editor to use the latest version.
subscribe: Cannot subscribe to this conversation. Run /web again in the CLI.
search: Cannot search conversations. Check that the local server is running.
busy: This conversation is busy. Try again shortly.
stale: This action expired or was handled by another client. Refreshing the conversation.
access: Cannot access the local server. Run /web again in the CLI.
input: The message is empty or too long. Edit it and try again.
missing: Conversation or project not found. Refresh the list.
operation: Action failed ({{code}}). Refresh and try again.
uncertain: The outcome could not be confirmed. Check the connection before retrying.
sessionNotFound: This conversation does not exist or was deleted.
list: Cannot load conversations. Check the local server or run /web again in the CLI.
history: Cannot load history. Try again; if the server restarted, run /web again in the CLI.
interrupted: The server restarted and interrupted the previous request. Check the conversation before sending a new request.
retryUncertain: The request outcome is uncertain. Retrying reuses the original request so the server can deduplicate it.
create: Could not create the conversation. Your draft is preserved; you can retry later.
unsaved: Session not saved. Saving will be retried on exit.
blocked: Execution state could not be confirmed. Exit and start a new session.
permissionSave: Could not save permissions: {{code}}. Previous permissions remain active.
exit: Exit failed. Press Ctrl+C to retry.
openBrowser: Open this URL in your browser: {{url}}
disconnected: Disconnected from the local server. Waiting to reconnect.
